# Harbor bulletin

A small project for preparing a public event bulletin.

The open studio is on 14 November, from 10:00 to 16:00, at Harbor Hall. Admission is free. Registration is required because the hall holds 80 visitors.

The event page is drafted. The accessibility review is complete. The registration form has not been tested, so the bulletin is not ready to publish.

The organisers have not decided which languages the bulletin must support. The project has no recorded answer to that question.
